name: move_task_from_backlog
description: Schedule one task from the user's Sunsama backlog onto a specific day. WRITE - the task moves into that day's Sunsama plan. Use it only when the user asked to schedule that specific backlog task on that day; general talk about backlog planning is not a request to move anything. It is not for tasks in any other app (Asana, Todoist, Jira, a calendar and so on).
